scene: You grab the buzzing drone and inspect its glowing keypad.
picture: A first-person close view of the captured drone filling the frame, held by two brown hands. On the far left of the panel is a blinking crimson button. In the centre sits a yellow notched dial with digital numbers. On the far right stands a slender silver toggle switch clicked upward.
shown: a blinking crimson button at the far left edge of the keypad
a bright yellow notched dial sitting right in the centre
a slender silver toggle switch on the far right side

variants.scene: The scuffed yellow drone buzzes gently in your steady hands.
A warm red light glows as tiny propellers whir softly above you.
Holding the chunky yellow machine, you hum {tune} over its quiet hum.
